name: Riso
reference: Risograph printing: two flat inks on uncoated paper that overprint into a third colour.
pattern: Uncoated white paper, fluorescent pink and teal inks that overprint, riso black for type.
personality: Printed by hand. Off-register layers stamp in one after another.

motion.character: Stamped: stepped motion at 12 fps, layers snapping in one by one, 1-3 px misregistration.
motion.transitions: A new ink layer stamps over the old one.

texture.note: Grain, halftone dots and slight misregistration between inks.

grammar: Two inks only, multiplied where they overlap.
Shapes are flat; tone comes from halftone, not gradients.
Type is ink, not a screen colour.

pictures.note: Two inks on paper: shadows in one ink, highlights in the other, off-register.

footage.note: A short clip printed in the same two inks.

music.feel: lo-fi hip-hop, dusty drums, warm, handmade

hits.note: A dull stamp as each ink layer prints.

compose.how: The print fills the frame under a band of paper at the top (lineInBand: the photo takes the picture box): the line in display, large, on the paper, where the print's inks are knocked out, as a two-colour print sets type. Ink over ink takes the line's contrast, so never set the line on the print.

hook.how: The main line (the name, when the film has one) in one ink on frame 0, large and cropped by the sheet edge. The other inks print the rest on the beats.

moves.move: One ink a beat: each layer stamps in one frame on a beat, never fades.

measurable.how: Each new layer appears in one frame, within 2 frames of a beat.

moves.move: Inks multiply where they overlap, 1-3 px off register.

measurable.how: The overprint colour (both inks multiplied) shows in at least one key frame.

moves.move: Tone comes from halftone dots, never a smooth gradient.

measurable.how: Moving things change on every second or third frame only.

props.passes: { beat: one bar }: one halftone layer per ink, overprinted

blocks.for: The hero picture, printed ink by ink.
A new ink layer that stamps over the old one.
A dull stamp as each ink prints.

avoid.why: Its rolls and pops tween every frame; print steps.

ends.how: The finished print: the last ink stamps on the bar, and the full sheet holds. Never blank paper.
ends.with: the last ink layer stamps (`enter: "cut"`) on the bar; the full sheet holds

mix.note: Dusty and warm. Each stamp lands on a beat; stamp again on each strong onset through a hold.

shots.match: Each picture in the same two inks and halftone screen.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a print fair poster with no date or place
